arcs.title: The Porch Railing Situation
arcs.summary: Day 1: Steve has identified a section of the porch railing that he believes is 'watching him.' No structural intervention has been made. He is watching it back. Christine has noted the situation in her household ledger under 'Ongoing.' Day 2 should develop the standoff — perhaps the railing does something minor but inexplicable, or Adam is consulted by Floo, or Don's portrait offers an opinion about the original installation that is both helpful and mildly incriminating.
